text:
carmen (CS): Heads-up — Fluxora renewal asking for split payment: 50% upfront on CC, 50% Net60 on a PO to their EU entity. They also say compliance requires a wet signature on the addendum (physical). Onboarding says workshops blocked until deposit posts. Thoughts?

zane (AE): I proposed a 9mo at flat price with 50/50 payment split to meet their procurement cadence. They insist the final signature must be an original signed page mailed back. Vendor codes: FLX-US-09, FLX-EU-21. I'll ask procurement for PO and mailing address.

natalie (Legal): Wet signature is unusual but doable. We'll generate a 1-page addendum with a wet-signature option: sign, scan, or courier original. Need to note acceptance of scanned PDF for activation to avoid delays. Draft wording: 

"Addendum: Customer may execute the addendum via wet (original) signature and return physical copy. For operational kickoff, Seller may accept a scanned copy of the executed addendum provided the original is received within 30 days."

leo (Onboarding): Operational impact: we can start initial setup after 50% deposit posts. If deposit not posted by 2026-06-05, workshop must be pushed two weeks. Can run a 60-min kickstart without hands-on lab.

carmen (CS): Can we do a DocuSign envelope that explicitly requests wet signature if they choose? Might confuse procurement. Better: create envelope for scanned acceptance + email courier details for original.

billing-bot: Provisional invoice IN-2026-7700 created (50% due now, remaining 50% pending PO). Default terms Net30 for remainder; mark for Net60 per request pending finance approval.

zane (AE): Proc sent PO for the balance: PO# EU-555-2026. Mailing address for originals: Fluxora Legal, 12 Harbor Rd, Dublin, IE. Asking if scanned copy is sufficient to start.

essign-bot: Envelope env-flx-wet created by carmen (CS). "Fluxora Renewal - Split Payment Addendum" pending: Fluxora Procurement (scan), carmen (CS), zane (AE). Link: https://esign.example/env-flx-wet

natalie (Legal): Countersigned addendum with wet-sign option included. Carmen, please send instructions to procurement: scan for immediate start, courier original within 30 days. Add accounting note for Net60 on remainder.

billing-bot: Remainder invoice updated to Net60 as approved. New refs: IN-2026-7700-A (50% upfront), IN-2026-7700-B (Net60). Accounting note: treat upfront as deferred revenue until kickoff.

zane (AE): Procurement emailed scanned signed addendum and PO. Uploaded to envelope and attached scanned page. Also asked for confirmation that scanned copy starts provisioning.

essign-bot: Scanned addendum uploaded by zane (AE) to env-flx-wet.

leo (Onboarding): Deposit posted — starting limited provisioning. Scheduling kickoff for 2026-06-07 (workshop tentatively 2026-06-21). I'll confirm once original arrives.

carmen (CS): Great. I notified them we'll accept scanned copy to start and to courier the original within 30 days. I'll run a short feedback pulse at kickoff around account admin friction. Closing thread.
file_note: Renewal thread: split payment (50% CC + 50% PO Net60), wet-signature requirement with scanned-copy acceptance, DocuSign envelope for addendum, billing split invoices, onboarding kickoff contingent on deposit.
